comment: The behind the scenes construction footage was a nice addition. Doesn't change my view of the challenge itself.
The confrontation between Jake and the group — both sides had valid points depending on how you frame the rules.
marcus got very little screen time before the elimination. was there more footage that didn't make the cut
the confrontation scene is the clearest point in the video where the competition stopped being about navigation and became about social dynamics
The interesting variable here is that by hour 50 with three people left the challenge should have been more intense than it was. the editing let it breathe too much
priya being two sections away at hour 90 means she covered more of the maze in her final push than anyone else imo
